no-restricted-syntax.message: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] is the UTC date. For a shop in India it returns TOMORROW between 18:30 and midnight UTC, so an evening entry is filed against the wrong day and vanishes from that day's report. Use todayIST() from @/lib/utils.
new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) is the UTC date — wrong for a shop in India after 18:30 UTC. Use todayIST() from @/lib/utils.
